title: CliContract
description: CLI interface specification for qa-pilot executable command

init.description: Initialize qa-pilot Skill, MCP server config, and test scaffolding in target project

--dry-run.description: Preview files that would be created/updated without modifying disk

--force.description: Overwrite existing skill or scaffold files without prompting

--skip-scaffold.description: Skip creating tests/ directory and playwright.config.ts

exitCodes.1: Invalid arguments or target directory unreadable
exitCodes.2: File permission error or write failure
